method: AI generated with the Codex built-in image tool (GPT image), one image at a time, 1024x1536, with the game's own character art and the five mission backdrops attached as style references. sharp used for cover resize and WebP encoding (cards 640x960 q82, thumbnails 96x144 q78) via the shared _shared/reward-cards/convert.cjs. Frame, stars, rarity label and title are drawn by code (src/reward-cards.js), not painted into the art.
sharedStyle: Cute chibi anime sticker style with soft cel shading and clean dark outlines exactly matching the reference characters: the detective boy with messy black hair, teal eyes, a white zip hoodie with teal hood and teal trim, dark backpack, black cargo pants and blue-and-white sneakers, holding a round magnifying glass; and his partner girl with long wavy dark-brown hair, a purple headband with a small bow, lavender sweatshirt, blue cargo jeans, lavender sneakers and a grey crossbody bag, hugging a grey tablet. Vertical 2:3 full-bleed card art, no frame, no text, no letters, no numbers; bright cheerful victory scenes showing positive hygiene actions only (no germs, no villains).
license: 확인 필요: 생성 당시 ChatGPT 계정 이용 조건은 다른 AI 생성 그림과 같이 납품 때 대조한다. 원본 PNG는 asset-bank/original(Git 제외)에 둔다.
